_about: Hand-kept list (not made by any import): moments in the Oral History video essays shown as 'Hear it remembered' buttons on heritage pages. page = heritage page slug; chapter = number at the start of the chapter title on the Oral History page; start = seconds into that chapter's VIDEO essay (from its subtitle file, a second or two early); quote = Isa's own words.
speaker: Isa Dean

clips.quote: My father was working in the pottery, and my mother went into working the pottery too.
I was all over it, I can tell you every place in it.
My mother was very keen on the live theatre… we used to imitate the pierrots that was on the sand.
I played on the beach because there was a cluster of rocks… and we'd play shops.
I went along the beach with my wee axe and if the wood was big, I used to chop it.
